summary: Add an opt-in encrypted password gesture accessed from the Settings heading.

changes.title: Hidden password vault setup
changes.detail: Hold the main Settings heading for three seconds and release, confirm the Android device credential, enter a password and enroll three consistent patterns in a practice footer.

changes.title: Isolated password insertion
changes.detail: Draw in the dedicated center footer of a masked password editor. Direct commit bypasses swipe decoding, voice and clipboard. Reject stale editors, ordinary text, protected apps and accessibility touch exploration; no auto-submit.

changes.title: Encrypted local mapping
changes.detail: AES-256-GCM in no-backup storage with Android Keystore; Smart mode uses recent device credential authentication, explicit Instant mode requires an unlocked secure device. Five failed matches require reauthentication. Preserve legacy biometric note and all voice code. Physical device validation pending.
